using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.TemplateEngine;
using Xunit;
using Moq;

namespace SemanticKernel.Core.Tests.TemplateEngine.Blocks
{
    public class VarBlockTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void Constructor_LogsError_WhenContentIsTooShort()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(loggerMock.Object);

            // Act
            var varBlock = new VarBlock("", loggerFactoryMock.Object);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString() == "The variable name is empty"),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void IsValid_LogsError_WhenContentIsNullOrEmpty()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(loggerMock.Object);
            var varBlock = new VarBlock(null, loggerFactoryMock.Object);

            // Act
            var isValid = varBlock.IsValid(out string errorMsg);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(isValid);
            Assert.Contains("A variable must start with the symbol", errorMsg);
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("A variable must start with the symbol")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void IsValid_LogsError_WhenContentDoesNotStartWithVarPrefix()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(loggerMock.Object);
            var varBlock = new VarBlock("xName", loggerFactoryMock.Object);

            // Act
            var isValid = varBlock.IsValid(out string errorMsg);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(isValid);
            Assert.Contains("A variable must start with the symbol", errorMsg);
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("A variable must start with the symbol")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void IsValid_LogsError_WhenContentLengthLessThanTwo()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(loggerMock.Object);
            var varBlock = new VarBlock("$", loggerFactoryMock.Object);

            // Act
            var isValid = varBlock.IsValid(out string errorMsg);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(isValid);
            Assert.Equal("The variable name is empty", errorMsg);
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString() == "The variable name is empty"),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.TemplateEngine;
using Xunit;
using Moq;

namespace SemanticKernel.Core.Tests.TemplateEngine.Blocks
{
    // We cannot access VarBlock directly because it is internal sealed.
    // We test the logging behavior indirectly by creating a derived class of Block
    // that mimics the relevant behavior for the constructor and IsValid method.
    internal class TestBlock : Block
    {
        public TestBlock(string? content, ILoggerFactory? loggerFactory = null) : base(content, loggerFactory)
        {
            if (this.Content.Length < 2)
            {
                this.Logger.LogError("The variable name is empty");
                return;
            }
        }

        public override bool IsValid(out string errorMsg)
        {
            errorMsg = string.Empty;

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(this.Content))
            {
                errorMsg = $"A variable must start with the symbol $ and have a name";
                this.Logger.LogError(errorMsg);
                return false;
            }

            if (this.Content[0] != '$')
            {
                errorMsg = $"A variable must start with the symbol $";
                this.Logger.LogError(errorMsg);
                return false;
            }

            if (this.Content.Length < 2)
            {
                errorMsg = "The variable name is empty";
                this.Logger.LogError(errorMsg);
                return false;
            }

            return true;
        }
    }

    public class VarBlockLoggingTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void Constructor_LogsError_WhenContentIsTooShort()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();

            // Act
            var block = new TestBlock("", loggerFactoryMock.Object);

            // Assert

                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString() == "The variable name is empty"),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

            // Act
            var isValid = block.IsValid(out string errorMsg);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(isValid);
            Assert.Contains("A variable must start with the symbol", errorMsg);
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("A variable must start with the symbol")),

        }
